Learn how to face unusual pieces by defeating the [[Human]] polymock player.
 
==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Defeat [[Necromancer Volumandus]] in a game of [[Polymock]] at [[Tarnished Haven]].
* See [[Hoff]] [Polymock Master] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* [[Ice Elemental Polymock piece]]
* {{Skill icon|Summon Ice Imp}}

==Walkthrough==
Volumandus' pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
#[[Skeletal Mage Form|Skeletal Mage]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Overload}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Backfire}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Diversion}}
#[[Smoke Wraith Form|Smoke Wraith]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Lightning Strike}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Mind Shock}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Lightning Blast}}
#[[Bone Dragon Form|Bone Dragon]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Deathly Chill}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Rising Bile}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Poisoned Ground}}

*Use [[Earth Elemental Polymock piece]] against [[Skeletal Mage Form|Skeleton Polymock piece]]
**Use [[Polymock Ether Signet]] to remove his [[Polymock Diversion]]
*Use [[Fire Imp Polymock piece]] or if you have it [[Fire Elemental Polymock piece]] against [[Smoke Wraith Form]]
*Use [[Kappa Polymock piece]] or if you have it [[Aloe Seed Polymock piece]] against [[Bone Dragon Form]]

:''Be wary of your next opponent, [Character Name]. The black arts provide him insight and powers no creature should possess. His Polymock pieces are from a set crafted with dark magic long considered destroyed. Will you challenge [[Necromancer Volumandus]] to a game?''

:''So you defeated the Necromancer and he didn't turn you into a bone minion? Two victories for the price of one, I say. Well done! Someday you'll have to tell me your strategy.''
